paite: Kumpipa Darias akum lina in hichi ahong hi a, Kisleu kha, akha kuana, ani li ni in, Zekariah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Dotna
english: In the fourth year of King Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

paite: Huan amau Bethel a omte'n Serezer leh Regem-melek leh amite uh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in asawl ua,
english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat Yahweh’s favor,

paite: sepaihte' TOUPA' inn a siampute kiang leh zawlneite kiang a thu va gen ding in, "Kum tampi sung ka na hihsa bang in akha ngana ah kei-le-kei kihihtuam in, kap a suun in an ka ngawl diam?" chi in.
english: and to speak to the priests of the house of Yahweh of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

paite: Huai lai in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Then the word of Yahweh of Armies came to me, saying,

paite: "Gam a mite tengteng kiang leh siampute kiang ah thugen in. Hiai kum sawmsagih sung, akha ngana leh akha sagihna a an na ngolh chiang un, kei a ding in, keimah ding in na ngawlta uhia?
english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

paite: Na nek chiang un, na dawn chiang un, noumau a mah ding in na ne un, na dawn uh ahi kei maw?
english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

paite: "Jerusalem akiluah lai leh ahauhsak lai a, akimvel a khopite leh Sim leh gam niam gam akiluah lai a zawlnei masate zang a TOUPA tangkoupih hiai thute ahi kei ua hia? chi in," chi in.
english: Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Zekariah kiang ah hiai bang in ahong tung hi.
heading: Thumanlouhna Gah Saltanna
english: Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen hi: "Vaihawmna dik hih un, michih in a-unau tung ah zahngaihna leh lainatna ensak hen.
english: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

paite: Meithai nuaisiah kei un, pabeite, mikhual, gentheite leng, na lak ua kuamah in alungtang in a-unau siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah kei hen, chi in,” achi hi.
english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

paite: Himahleh ngaihkhiak a-ut kei ua, genhaktak in akiheimang ua, azaklouhna ding un abil uh ahum uhi.
english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

paite: Ahi, suang tak bang in alungtang uh abawl ua, huchi keileh dan aza kha ding ua, zawlnei masate khut a ama Kha a sepaihte' TOUPA'N athukhakte aza kha ding uh; huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan nakpi a hehna ahong tung hi.
english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which Yahweh of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Ka kikou lai a angaihkhiak louh ziak un akikou chiang un leng ka ngaikhe sam kei ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said Yahweh of Armies;

paite: "Himahleh atheih louh uh namte lam ah pingpei in amaute ka delhsak ding. Huchi in gam amau nung in akisegawp ding a, kuamah in akantan un alehkik kei ding uh; gam nuam asukgawp ziak un, achi," chi in.
english: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”
